abstract: A new study shows that, although it lacks the common genetic toolkit, Arabidopsis can form a functional mycorrhizal symbiosis. This finding challenges the non-mycorrhizal status of Arabidopsis and the requirement of a complete common genetic toolkit for endomycorrhizal symbiosis.
